correctness.rationale: Finite-generation induction covers every unlabelled tree, AHU center-rooted code removes exactly isomorphisms, and all 987 trees through order 12 were grouped by 2n+1 exact integer moments. Block-matrix Cayley–Hamilton proves those prefixes decide the infinite profiles. One pair at order 12 is checked by equal matching polynomials, equal first 12 moments, and common recurrence; determinant lemma proves its generalized-spectrum equality. Independent NetworkX census replicated all counts. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact minimum order at which restricted path-counting queries cease to separate trees is a natural first-occurrence invariant. The complete 987-tree census shows the path-only equivalence partition unexpectedly agrees with the strictly information-richer generalized-spectrum partition through order 12. This is a motivated boundary for finite-model counting-query expressivity, not an arbitrary sliced parameter; it can serve as a sharp reconstruction benchmark.
